impact: During the 2026-09-15/16 dual-provider outage, Gemini capacity failures were reported as parse errors, which reads as a bridge bug rather than a provider outage and defeats usage-based failover logic. Classify HTTP 503 / empty result events as PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE with the upstream message retained.
resolution: Commit d1f8a20. Gemini 503/unavailable/no-capacity/overloaded/try-again-later errors classify as PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (failover-eligible); agy's init.model event is observed and recorded per session so the observed label reflects the runtime.
title: Gemini 503 / no-capacity responses surface as RESPONSE_PARSE_ERROR (empty or malformed JSON) instead of a provider-unavailable classification
